tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shrī nā tha sa pa ri wā ra s+ya sto traṃ shatrūn bigh+nān prā ṇo pats+tshe da tsakra nā ma bi ha ra tisma/ ༄༅/ /dpal mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod pa dgra bgegs srog gcod kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shri badz+ri ma hā kā lā pañja ra nā tha de bī re ba tī tsa badz+ra ma hā kā la tsa turmu khā di shā sa no rak+ṣa ka sa mu dra sa pa ri wā ra s+yasto traṃ sha truṃ bigh+nān prā ṇo pats+tshe da tsakra nā maḥ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lha mo nam gru ma rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa la sogs pa'i bstan srung rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod pa dgra bgegs srog gcod kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba po/ /mgon po gri gug thod pa can/ /kha dog nag cing ro la zhon/ nag po che la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhal ni mche ba cher gtsigs shing / ljags 'dril shin tu 'jigs rung ba/ /spyan ni kun tu dmar zhing zlum/ /nag po che la༞ dpa' bo stag lpags na bza' dang / khro bo bcu yi rang bzhin can/ nyi ma bcu gnyis gzi ldan pa/ /nag po che la༞ smin ma bsdus shing spyan gsum pa/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes/ /de bzhin dus mtha'i 'od dmar can/ /nag po che la༞ mgo phreng bzang po rnam par 'dzin/ /klu yi rgyal po rnams kyis brgyan/ /'khyog cing thung ba'i sma ra can/ /nag po che la༞ sangs bstan pa 'jig byed pa'i/ /skye bo la ni rnam sdang zhing / /rab tu rig pas rtag sgrol ba'i/ /nag po che la༞ 'khor ba'i mtsho las pha rol tu/ /sangs rgyas theg pas bgrod pa rnams/ /bsgral bya'i gnas su sgrol byed pa/ /nag po che la༞ gang zhig legs par mnyam bzhag pas/ /nag po che brgyad klog byed pa/ /bsod nams des ni 'jigs nyams shing / /'dod pa nges par grub gyur cig

/ces pa 'di ni/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po la bstod pa tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba'i skabs te dang po'o// //bh+yoḥdapal ldan lha mo re ba ti/ /srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing / /'dod khams mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mchog /dus mtshan nag mo khyod la bstod/ /nam gru khyod kyi cho 'brang dang / /mtshan nyid dag ni bshad bya ba/ /nor bu'i rang bzhin khyod kyi lus/ /rgyab ni dzam+bu chu bo'i gser/ /khyod kyi gdong yang dngul yin te/ /lto ba'i ngos ni rdo rjes gtams/ /ming po mdzod dang mdzod bsrung ba/ /khyod kyi ma ni kun 'gro ma/ /khyod kyi pha ni rlung zhes bya/ /skal ldan shing rta khyod kyi rus/ /lha gnas gsum du grags pa yin/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod la bstod/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ba'i tshal/ /yongs 'du'i shing la nyer brten zhing / /'jig rten gsum gyi dge legs kun/ /nye bar stsol mdzad khyod la bstod/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi shar lho'i mtshams/ /de bī ko ṭar gnas bcas shing / /bha ṭa'i shing la rab brten ma/ /zhing skyong gtso mo khyod la bstod/ /gang gi khyod kyi mtshan 'dzin pa/ /de la lha klu mi rnams kyis/ /rims nad gnod pa zhi mdzad cing / /dgra bgegs tshar gcod khyod la bstod/ /shin tu gus pa'i yid ldan pas/ /nam gru brgyad pa 'di brjod na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /'dod pa'i don kun 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni/ dpal ldan lha mo nam gru ma la bstod pa 'chi med dpal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// //hūm̐ dpal ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur ba/ /nag po chen po mi zad gtsigs/ /mchu 'phyang shugs che byis pa'i gzugs/ /drag po'i sgra sgrogs khyod la bstod/ /dpa' bo mi mgo'i phreng ba 'dzin/ /ming gi rnam grangs du ma can/ /'jigs rung gri gug thod pa dang / mdung thung bum pa 'dzin la bstod/ /mi mgo rlon po'i do shal byas/

/sa 'og k+ṣiṃ gi sgra sgrog pa/ /ti se'i gangs dang gru 'dzin du/ /nyer gnas nag po che la bstod/ /ser skya khyod ni zhing skyong mdzad/ /hā hā hūm̐ hūm̐ gad rgyangs sgrog /sngon gyi zhal bzhes dam bcas rnams/ /mkhyen par mdzod cig nag po che/ /sha chen zan gyi gtor ma dang / /me tog spos 'di snoms mdzod la/ /phyogs bcu kun dang khyad par du/ /byang phyogs bstan pa skyong bar mdzod/ /g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo dang / /siṅgha'i gling gi lha mo rnams/ /gtor ma longs la dngos grub stsol/ /rnam par gnag pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /mtshon chas bsnun cing zhags pas chings/ /ye shes me yis bsregs 'tshos la/ /myur du bsad cing rnam par shes/ /rgyal ba'i zhing du sgrol bar mdzod/ /rtse gcig dad pa'i sems kyis su/ /gsang sngags bzlas dang mchod brtson pas/ /dpal ldan brgyad pa 'dis bstod na/ /mchog dang thun mong kun stsol cig /ces pa 'di ni/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa la bstod pa dgra bgegs zil gnon dpa' bo'i 'brug sgra zhes bya ba'i skabs te gsum pa'o// //hūm̐ dur khrod sha za kun gyi gtso/ /rab dkar keng rus brjid pa'i sku/ /dam tshig can la brtser dgongs pa'i/ /nor gyi bdag po yab yum bstod/ /hūm̐ ma hā kā la lcam dral gyi/ /bka' nyan nag po gnod sbyin ni/ /gser gyi gri gug 'bar ba dang / /thod khrag zhal du gsol la bstod/ /maḥde yi yum mchog gnod sbyin mo/ /mgo 'phreng byu ru'i rgyan cha can/ /rdo rje'i spu gri rnon po yis/ /dgra bgegs snying 'byin khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐ rab brjid dpa' bo srin po'i gzugs/ /mdog nag lcags kyi shang lang dang / /dam nyams thod khrag phyag na bsnams/ /las mkhan pu tra khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐ mon bu bha ṭa nag po ni/ /dam shing mi snying rlon pa thogs/ /stag gi lpags pa'i na bza' can/ /gshin rje'i gzugs can khyod la bstod/

/bh+yoḥde yi mched mo ral gcig ma/ /mi yi rgyu ma'i phreng ba dang / /gser gyi spu gri rab 'dzin zhing / /kha nas me 'bar khyod la bstod/ /bh+yoḥdapal ldan dkar mo nyi zla ni/ /dar dkar 'jol ber sku la gsol/ /ri rab gling bzhi phyag na bsnams/ /skye 'gro gso mdzad khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐ dpal chen bka' yi pho nya ni/ /rlung gi shugs can bdud rta'i steng / /mdog nag ru mtshon thod phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rgyal nag po khyod la bstod/ /ces pa 'di ni/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po dang las mgon rnams la bstod pa ma rung tshar gcod rdo rje'i mtshon cha zhes bya ba'i skabs te bzhi pa'o// //hūm̐ bdud rta bra nag rus rgyan can/ /de steng gshin rje khros pa'i sku/ /ba dan mi snying khram shing thogs/ /srog bdag nag po khyod la bstod/ /bh+yoḥslob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /spyan sngar khas blangs bdag nyid ma/ /shwa na mu kha bse mo bzhi/ /phung srung rnams la bstod par bgyi/ /rdo rje gur gyi mgon po dang / /lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /zhing skyong drag po zhal bzhi sogs/ /bstan srung 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas dang / /sna tshogs mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bka' bzhin du/ /thub pa'i bstan pa bsrung bar mdzod/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan bstan pa dang / /rnam dkar phrin las rab rgyas shing / /dge 'dun sde rnams 'phel bar mdzod/ /khyad par bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /'gal rkyen nad gdon kun zhi nas/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang / /'khor dang dbang thang rgyas par mdzod/ /lha 'dre mi yi 'gro ba rnams/ /phan tshun byams pa'i sems ldan zhing / /bdag gi dbang du bsdus nas kyang / /theg mchog lam du 'jug par mdzod/ /phyi dus bstan pa'i mjug 'di ru/ /dam nyams log pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /zhi bas 'dul bar mi nus la/ /drag po'i rtags mtshan ma bstan na/

/lha dang sgrub la brnyas 'gyur bas/ /las mkhan sprul pa yang sprul dang / /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /drag po'i mthu rtsal dpung bskyed la/ /'jigs rung cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs/ /skyob pa'i lha srung kun bral te/ /mngon sum bzhin du 'dir khug la/ /myur du bsad cing bsgral bar gyis/ /mdor na zhi rgyas dbang drag gi /phrin las gang bcol de dag rnams/ /thogs pa med par sgrub pa dang / /ci bsam don rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i gsang ba'i las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po dang phur srung rnams la bstod cing dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'dod don thogs med phrin las kyi rnga sgra zhes bya ba'i skabs te lnga pa'o/ /de ltar bstod pa dang phrin las gzhol ba'i tshig 'di dag las/ dpal gur gyi mgon po la bstod pa 'di ni 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu lo chen gyis bsgyur ba las tshig gong 'og cung zad 'don pa bsgyur ba yin zhing / lha mo 'dod khams ma'i bstod pa 'di ni bya rgyud rig pa mchog gi rgyud las phyag na rdo rjes nam gru'i rigs dang cho 'brang la bstod pa ji bzhin la/ gong 'og gi tshigs bcad kha yar bsnan pa yin/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i bstod pa ni/ rtsa ba'i sngags bod skad du bsgyur ba la gzhi byas/ bar skabs su tshig gi snon phri cung zad byas pa yin la/ las mgon rnams la mngon rtogs dang mthun par bstod cing / phrin las bcol ba'i tshig 'di dag snga mo nas rtsom pa'i bsam pa yod kyang / le lo'i dbang gis ma grub pa la mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong gis brtsams na dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur cung zad mthong nas sa skyong zhes pa shing mo bya'i lo gtsang phyogs su dus ngan gyi 'khrug long sna tshogs byung ba'i dus mgo zla ba'i dkar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes brgyad la/

gza' lhag pa dang / skar ma khrum stod kyi 'chi sbyor biṣ+ṭi rgyu ba'i drag po'i tshes la/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong rig sngags 'chang ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gi 'dod don ci rigs 'grub pa'i phyir/ shab rgo lnga bar sdings dza ḍa'i gling du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni zla ba grags pa'o// //e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
